cards.name: Grookey
cards.description: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.description: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it's a Sudowoodo, not a tree. It hides from the rain.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.description: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.description: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.description: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

cards.name: Mudbray
cards.description: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon. It's skilled at making use of mud.

cards.name: Mudsdale
cards.description: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.

cards.name: Silicobra
cards.description: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

cards.name: Silicobra
cards.description: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

cards.name: Sandaconda
cards.description: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

cards.name: Grookey
cards.description: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

cards.name: Sandaconda
cards.description: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

cards.name: Clobbopus
cards.description: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

cards.name: Clobbopus
cards.description: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

cards.name: Grapploct
cards.description: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

cards.name: Stonjourner
cards.description: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

cards.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
cards.description: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

cards.name: Galarian Linoone
cards.description: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

cards.name: Galarian Obstagoon
cards.description: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

cards.name: Thwackey
cards.description: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.description: It attacks using the claws on its tail. Once locked in its grip, its prey is unable to move as this Pokémon's poison seeps in.

cards.name: Drapion
cards.description: It's so vicious that it's called the Sand Demon. Yet when confronted by Hippowdon, Drapion keeps a low profile and will never pick a fight.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.description: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.

cards.name: Nickit
cards.description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

cards.name: Thievul
cards.description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

cards.name: Galarian Meowth
cards.description: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

cards.name: Galarian Perrserker
cards.description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Thwackey
cards.description: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.description: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.description: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

cards.name: Galarian Stunfisk
cards.description: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

cards.name: Corviknight
cards.description: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

cards.name: Cufant
cards.description: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

cards.name: Copperajah
cards.description: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

cards.name: Rillaboom
cards.description: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.description: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.description: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.description: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.description: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.description: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.description: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.description: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

cards.name: Rillaboom
cards.description: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

cards.name: Rookidee
cards.description: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

cards.name: Corvisquire
cards.description: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

cards.name: Wooloo
cards.description: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

cards.name: Wooloo
cards.description: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

cards.name: Dubwool
cards.description: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

cards.name: Blipbug
cards.description: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

cards.name: Blipbug
cards.description: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

cards.name: Dottler
cards.description: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

cards.name: Orbeetle
cards.description: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.description: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.

cards.name: Gossifleur
cards.description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

cards.name: Eldegoss
cards.description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.description: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.description: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit's poisonous gas.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.description: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.description: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.description: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.description: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.description: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

cards.name: Raboot
cards.description: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

cards.name: Raboot
cards.description: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

cards.name: Cinderace
cards.description: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

cards.name: Cinderace
cards.description: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

cards.name: Cinderace
cards.description: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

cards.name: Sizzlipede
cards.description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

cards.name: Sizzlipede
cards.description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

cards.name: Centiskorch
cards.description: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.description: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.description: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.description: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.description: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.description: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

cards.name: Kingler
cards.description: The large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.description: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.description: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.description: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.description: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.description: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.description: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.

cards.name: Sobble
cards.description: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

cards.name: Sobble
cards.description: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

cards.name: Drizzile
cards.description: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

cards.name: Drizzile
cards.description: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

cards.name: Inteleon
cards.description: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

cards.name: Inteleon
cards.description: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.description: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

cards.name: Chewtle
cards.description: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

cards.name: Drednaw
cards.description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

cards.name: Cramorant
cards.description: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

cards.name: Snom
cards.description: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

cards.name: Frosmoth
cards.description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.description: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.description: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.description: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.description: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

cards.name: Yamper
cards.description: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

cards.name: Yamper
cards.description: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

cards.name: Boltund
cards.description: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

cards.name: Boltund
cards.description: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

cards.name: Pincurchin
cards.description: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

cards.name: Durant
cards.description: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

cards.name: Galarian Ponyta
cards.description: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

cards.name: Galarian Rapidash
cards.description: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.description: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.description: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

cards.name: Munna
cards.description: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.description: It drowses and dreams all the time. It's best to leave it be if it's just woken up, as it's a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

cards.name: Sinistea
cards.description: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

cards.name: Polteageist
cards.description: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.description: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.description: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.description: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.description: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.description: It relies on its carapace to deflect incoming attacks and throw its enemy off balance. As soon as that happens, it drives its drill into the foe.
